newsitem.title: USA: Empire District proposes rate increase.
newsitem.headline: Empire District proposes rate increase.

text.p: Empire District Electric Co said it filed a general request with the Missouri Public Service Commission to increase rates for electric customers.
The proposed rate increase would boost Empire District's annual revenues by about $23.4 million or 13.8 percent, the company said.

The commission recently rejected the utility's earlier request for interim rate relief to recover expenses associated with the increased cost of fuel. The commission said the interim rate request could not be considered without a general request.
The rate hike would mean an additional $6.85 a month charge for residential customers using 700 kilowatt-hours per month, the company said.
